Tab reaches Close, Enter closes it, Escape also dismisses it, and NVDA+Tab confirms focus returned to Enlarge cover image, button, focused, collapsed.

Closing the outer details dialog after a mouse-opened/nested cover flow still produced Unlabelled graphic speech, as in the baseline; no general outer-dialog focus pass is claimed.
